name: combined
_notes: v3: v2's model, data and settings, plus (1) the quality filter (broken CMU frames cut out, duplicate CMU takes dropped), (2) joint and hips limit losses from the data's own ranges (motionlab/assets/joint_limits.json), (3) rollouts on to 64 and 128 ticks (about 2 s alone) with longer windows. Validation is at the last phase: horizon 128, window 168.
